from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib
ROOT=Path.cwd();OUT=ROOT/'reports/research/510300_historical_pmi_survey_regime_source_v1'
n=json.loads((ROOT/'reports/research/510300_original_survey_information_cutoff_population_v1/next_experiment.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
assert n['experiment_id']=='E69'
for z in n['parents']:assert hashlib.sha256((ROOT/z['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==z['sha256']
p=dict(n);p['registered_at']=datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat();p['status']='REGISTERED_TWO_HISTORICALLY_APPLICABLE_SURVEY_REGIME_OBJECTS_BEFORE_SEARCH'
p['queries']=[
{'target_year':2019,'q':'2019 采购经理调查 统计报表制度 调查时间 报送','domains':['stats.gov.cn']},
{'target_year':2020,'q':'2020 采购经理调查 统计报表制度 调查时间 春节','domains':['stats.gov.cn']}]
p['previous_goal_turn_classification']='PROGRESS_E67_ACTUAL_EMPLOYMENT_CAUSE_OBJECTS_AND_SURVEY_INFORMATION_SCOPE_E68_FULL_ORIGINAL_CUTOFF_SUPPORT_MAPPED'
p['root_consecutive_blocked_goal_turns']=0
f=OUT/'protocol.json';assert not f.exists();f.write_text(json.dumps(p,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'实际登记':'E69','固定两个原制度年度':[2019,2020],'查询/GET上限':[2,2],'金融模型/标签/账户/源码预算':0},ensure_ascii=False))
